page.overview:
Who is Colton Herta?

Herta has been frequently mentioned in discussions about American drivers entering Formula One. In 2022, he tested a McLaren Formula One car as part of their young driver development program. He was also considered by Red Bull Racing as a potential replacement for Pierre Gasly at AlphaTauri, though he was ultimately denied the FIA Super Licence points required to compete.

In 2025, Herta was linked to the new Cadillac F1 Team due to reports they were interested in acquiring an American driver for their team. These reports were strengthened by the fact that he was linked to Cadillac as he drove for Andretti Autosport, who will co-own Cadillac in 2026. However, he was not signed by Cadillac, who instead decided to sign Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas for their 2026 campaign.

Herta was born in Santa Clarita, California. He began karting at a young age and quickly rose through the ranks of American junior motorsport. In 2014, he moved to Europe to race in the Cooper Tires USF2000 Championship Powered by Mazda, before switching to the MSA Formula Championship (now British F4) in the United Kingdom.

In 2016, Herta competed in the Euroformula Open Championship with Carlin, finishing third overall, and also contested a part-season in the FIA Formula 3 European Championship.
